task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel UV_Vis benchmark chart, variant 01. Scenario: three overlapping spectra.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel UV-Vis spectrum benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel UV-Vis absorbance plot with three spectra and an in-panel legend at upper right. No explicit panel label is printed, so the target panel is the full figure. Crop conservatively retains all tick labels, axis labels, and legend; anchors are recorded in original-figure coordinates from visible major tick marks.

x.visible_pattern: Bottom-axis ticks labeled 300 through 800 are evenly spaced across the panel.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE 0.0002; spacing is visually uniform across the visible major ticks.

y.visible_pattern: Left-axis ticks labeled 0.0 through 1.2 in 0.2 increments are evenly spaced vertically.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with effectively zero normalized RMSE; the visible zero tick also makes log10 incompatible.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: Crowding is limited to brief crossings and a weak near-baseline right-tail convergence; there is no meaningful hidden segment that warrants a separate recovery pass.

curves.overlap_notes: Brief crossing with the blue dashed spectrum near x about 560 and a close pass beneath the red spectrum near x about 610; the black trace remains visually trackable.
Dashed spectrum crosses the black spectrum around x about 560 and approaches the red spectrum on the far-right near-baseline tail from roughly x about 980 onward.
Dash-dot spectrum stays below the other traces until the right-side tail, where it becomes the uppermost trace while remaining close to the blue tail.

response.interpretation_notes: Three main-plot UV-Vis spectra correspond directly to the legend entries. The required QA pass was kept without revision: all curves passed individually, while pairwise review warnings are limited to genuine close tail crowding near the baseline.
unresolved_ambiguities: All three traces compress near the baseline on the far-right tail, producing pairwise overlap-review warnings despite acceptable per-curve QA.
Sample A and Sample B briefly cross near x about 560, but both traces remain identifiable before and after the crossing.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
